questions.question: How old is Marek when he hears about Mars?
questions.explanation: Marek is eight when Viking sends the first pictures.

questions.question: What does Marek see in the first picture from Viking?
questions.explanation: He points at a rock formation that looks like a face.

questions.question: What does the Perseverance rover discover in Jezero crater?
questions.explanation: Marek talks about an ancient river delta — a good place to look for traces of life.

questions.question: What is the name of the rock with round spots?
questions.explanation: Perseverance found the rock Cheyava Falls.

questions.question: What does the father say about the mistake with the canals on Mars?
answers: It proved there is life on Mars
It was more important than the truth
questions.explanation: The father says the mistake made people start dreaming.
